findings.summary: The new wiring test 'writes nothing when every checkout is already trusted' computes its expected trusted-set with the real `existsSync` (via its own unguarded `trustableDirs(REPO_ROOT)` call) but exercises `main()` through `spyIo`'s default `exists: () => true` stub, so the two derivations of the primary checkout's path can disagree and the test fails on any machine/lane where the `web-everything

`readTrust()` parses `~/.claude.json` with a bare `JSON.parse` and no try/catch, so a transiently-invalid or corrupted read of that actively, concurrently-written CLI state file throws and takes down the entire SessionStart hook (skills, commands, memory, siblings, aliases, gitdir, trust) rather than just the trust step.
